sloka: तैः मुक्त केशैः समरे पतितैः शोणित उक्षितैः ।विस्तीर्णा वसुधा कृत्स्ना महावेदिः कुशैः इव ॥३-२६-३३॥
transliteration: taiḥ mukta keśaiḥ samare patitaiḥ śoṇita ukṣitaiḥ ।vistīrṇā vasudhā kṛtsnā mahāvediḥ kuśaiḥ iva ॥3-26-33॥

translations.english: The entire ground was littered with bodies of demons fallen in the battle with loose hair and with drops of blood on them looking like a great sacrificial altar strewn all over with kusa grass.
